Hiệp đọc kỹ thì thấy chính sách Vinhomes: Reading it closely, Hiep finds that the November 19, 2026 round of the Vinhomes Hai Van Bay policy is divided fairly clearly by need: buyers with spare capital should calculate the 7.5% early payment discount plus VinClub; buyers who actually want to live there should choose Bach Van with the 10% early move-in incentive; buyers needing passive cash flow should consider finished Dao Ngoc units with the 7%/year guarantee. This is the incentive most worth calculating in this round of the Vinhomes Hai Van Bay policy if you do not need bank leverage, because the discount is applied directly to the unit value.
